animations.name: fadeIn
animations.description: Simple opacity fade-in animation for revealing elements.

animations.name: fadeSlideUp
animations.css: @keyframes fadeSlideUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(2px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) } }
animations.description: Combined fade and upward slide animation for content reveals.

animations.name: fadeSlideRight
animations.css: @keyframes fadeSlideRight { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-2px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) } }
animations.description: Combined fade and rightward slide animation for horizontal content reveals.

animations.name: barGrow
animations.css: @keyframes barGrow { from { transform: scaleY(0) } to { transform: scaleY(1) } }
animations.description: Vertical scale animation for progress bars or chart elements.

animations.name: tilePopIn
animations.css: @keyframes tilePopIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.7) translateY(3px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0) } }
animations.description: Pop-in animation for tiles and cards with scale and position.

animations.name: navItemSlideIn
animations.css: @keyframes navItemSlideIn { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) } }
animations.description: Slide-in animation for navigation dropdown items.

animations.name: navItemFade
animations.description: Fade animation for navigation CTA button appearance.

animations.name: sonner-spin
animations.description: Loading spinner animation with opacity cycling for toast notifications.

animations.name: sonner-fade-in
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.8) } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) } }
animations.description: Toast notification entrance animation with scale and fade.

animations.name: global-transition
animations.description: Standard transition timing used for navigation items and interactive elements.

animations.name: button-transition
animations.description: Default transition for button hover states and interactions.

animations.name: gallery-marquee-item-slide-up
animations.description: Slide-up animation for gallery marquee items, timing: 1s cubic-bezier(.25, 1, .5, 1).

insights: The design system uses full-radius (pill-shaped) buttons exclusively for primary and secondary CTAs, creating a soft, approachable aesthetic that contrasts with the sharp edges of product UI mockups.
Interactive product demos are a core component pattern, using nested window chrome with draggable/resizable containers to showcase the IDE experience directly on the marketing page.

The color system relies heavily on alpha transparency variations of the primary graphite color (#26251E) for creating subtle hierarchy in borders, text states, and backgrounds rather than introducing additional hue values.
